research_question: With E054 candidate scores and E045 top-16 candidate pools held fixed, do E045's odd/even, low/high, consecutive-number penalties and decade-band bonus improve three-line portfolio outcomes relative to a score-only allocator?
novelty: A single pre-specified allocator ablation isolates the contribution of the existing E045 structural objective. It changes no candidate scores, candidate pool size, number of lines, line size, disjoint-union geometry, target range, random comparator, or inference thresholds.

evaluation.cutoff_rule: For each target t, every feature, regime, training outcome, and score uses only rounds <= t-1.
evaluation.rolling_design: Fixed model and allocator rules are applied independently at each target cutoff. No hyperparameter or variant selection is performed on the evaluation outcomes.

fixed_candidate_stage.candidate_pool: At each sequential ticket allocation, top 16 currently unused numbers by the frozen E054 score.

arms.name: E045_STRUCTURE_OBJECTIVE
arms.rule: Exact frozen E045 choose_disjoint_ticket: among all 6-number subsets of the top-16 pool, maximize score sum - 0.022*abs(odd_count-3) - 0.020*abs(low_count-3) - 0.010*max(0,consecutive_pairs-2) + 0.004*decade_band_count; lexicographic lower-number tie-break.

arms.name: SCORE_ONLY_TOP6_ABLATION
arms.rule: From the identical top-16 pool, choose the six highest E054 scores (same deterministic tie-break); remove selected numbers and repeat until exactly three pairwise-disjoint lines are produced. No structure terms.

matched_random.method: uniform random relabeling of 1..45 applied jointly to the three fixed lines, preserving exact disjoint union18 geometry

inference.ci: two-sided moving-block percentile interval at per-metric alpha 0.0125
inference.strict_historical_gate: All four adjusted CI lower bounds (max_hits, any2, any3, winning_union_coverage) strictly >0 and any2-positive non-overlapping block share >=0.65.
inference.paired_ablation_comparison: Same 4-metric adjusted moving-block CI on challenger-minus-baseline paired differences.

exclusions: No use of 1250 or 1251 outcomes in the 401..1249 evaluation target results.
No tuning, threshold relaxation, post-hoc variant creation, or promotion based on these already inspected historical rounds.
Rounds 1244..1249 are contaminated live-history diagnostics, not clean holdout.
This historical ablation cannot satisfy prospective confirmation or release purchase numbers.
No candidate list or purchase lines are included in the report.
promotion_effect: NONE; historical diagnostic only; no strict PASS-ready status, no prospective confirmation, no number release.
